steps: Rinse the quinoa; bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a medium saucepan, add quinoa, cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Drain and press the firm tofu for 10 minutes, then cut into 2 cm cubes.
Cut the broccoli into small florets; slice the red bell pepper and cooked carrot into thin strips; mince garlic and fresh ginger.
Whisk together the tamari, cornstarch, and 30 ml water in a small bowl to make the sauce.
Heat 15 ml canola oil in a large non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the firm tofu cubes and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden on most sides; transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining canola oil to the skillet; stir-fry the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the broccoli, red bell pepper, and carrot; stir-fry for 4 minutes until just tender.
Return the tofu to the skillet, pour over the sauce, and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until everything is coated and glossy.
Serve over quinoa and sprinkle with ground sesame seeds. Keeps refrigerated for 3 days or frozen for 1 month.
